missions.name: Homecoming
missions.summary: Jules arrives, chases a bag thief through the Lantern Quarter and drives home to an empty house.

missions.name: Empty Rooms
missions.summary: Nia shows Jules Teo's ransacked apartment; a beaten kid at the clinic points to Aurum.

missions.name: Lantern Lights
missions.summary: Free Celeste's bandleader from the precinct, survive an Aurum ambush and lose the police.

missions.name: Wharf Rats
missions.summary: Get into Warehouse 9 and learn Teo was running river cargo for the Krewe.

missions.name: Krewe Business
missions.summary: Meet Mama Odette, then fight off Aurum's boats in an airboat chase through the bayou.

missions.name: Gilded Invitation
missions.summary: Victor Hale asks a favour: recover High Water's car for Aurum, or give it back.

missions.name: Street Business
missions.summary: Open a food stand in the Floodline Wards and defend it; Moreau House becomes a safehouse.

missions.name: Hoops
missions.summary: Win a 3v3 streetball game against Dex's team to get Pops's information.

missions.name: Floodwater
missions.summary: On a storm night, follow the Drowned Streetcar to Teo's hideout and half of the ledger.

missions.name: Magnolia
missions.summary: Crack Victor Hale's safe during his garden party for the other half of the ledger.

missions.name: Crescent Bridge
missions.summary: Escape a citywide manhunt across the Crescent Bridge; Captain Reyes lets Jules go.

missions.name: Cargo
missions.summary: Rescue Teo from Aurum's cargo hangar before his plane leaves.
